text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

translations.asad: SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of men,
translations.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

translations.asad: "from the evil of the whispering, elusive tempter
translations.sahih: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

translations.asad: "who whispers in the hearts of men
translations.sahih: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

translations.asad: "from all [temptation to evil by] invisible forces as well as men,"
translations.sahih: From among the jinn and mankind."
